scope: descriptive Table S1 and schematic only; all inferential analyses carried unchanged
input: outputs/S1_writing/provenance/analysis_input.rds; independently verify against sealed public XPT files
population: adult flag from sealed input: age>=20, both reliable, DRABF!=1; positive WTDR2D
weight: WTDR2D within each cycle; no raking
categorical_display: unweighted n (WTDR2D-weighted %); denominator = variable nonmissing persons in each cycle; education invalid/refused/dont_know -> missing
non_English: valid harmonized language code !=1; includes bilingual interviews
proxy: sealed proxy1/proxy2 mapping, valid nonself respondents
weighted_quantiles: lower inverse empirical weighted CDF: smallest observed x with cumulative WTDR2D >= p * sum(WTDR2D), p=0.25 and 0.75; no interpolation
rounding: n integer with thousands separators; weighted means, percentages, quartiles 1 decimal, directly from full precision
tests: none; no P values, SEs, CIs, trends, or new correction estimates
